capabilities.scope: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, a battery-powered normal POWER-on boot from NOR reached the ESP_MOSAICO kernel and a single-user shell with an FFS memory-disk root. This does not establish NAND boot, full PSRAM read/write or general peripheral support.
Vendor-firmware WebUI and a bounded live-log connection observed. No EmberBSD radio or sustained-transfer result.
Type-C USB-OTG ROM connection and complete 16 MiB NOR readback verified with esptool 5.6.0. This does not establish an EmberBSD USB console or a successful firmware restore.

On one V1.2 sample, the vendor factory firmware showed a visible UI and touch responded. In EmberBSD, CO5300 framebuffer and CST9220 touch drivers attached; a touch trial produced changing coordinates and contact events. A diagnostic LVGL trial completed SPI transfers without reported errors while the display remained black. Later CO5300 status transactions completed without reported bus errors but yielded all-zero values. The published ESP32-S31 SPI change initializes data lines idle high; this revision has not been tried on the board. Orientation, calibration and audio function were not verified.

On one V1.2 sample, the left-slot camera EEPROM descriptor had valid CRCs and hardware-version field 0x0102. The factory firmware separately reported SC101IOT PID 0xda4a and rendered a changing 1280 × 720 UYVY preview. EmberBSD now publishes the optional ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT identity-only probe at 0x68; it expects PID 0xda4a and does not implement DVP capture. This configuration has not yet run on the board; the prior OV3640-specific probe does not identify this sensor. The factory result does not establish sensor identity for other modules.
